# AnchorNav

Scroll directly to the chosen section on the page with a list of links.
See [Anchor Navigation guidelines<i class="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/anchor-navigation/design/)

<Source code="import { AnchorNav } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the `<nav>` HTML element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/AnchorNav/index.ts)

### Placement

You can achieve appropriate placements in the layout on your own

<Canvas of={AnchorNavStories.Placement} />

```css
.anchornav-example {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 1rem;
  height: 400px;
  overflow-y: hidden;
}
```
